name: lastnormal_item_microscope_022

source_description_evidence: A classic tool for the ages!  This hefty, durable piece of lab equipment makes small things look bigger.  Without electricity the light doesn't work, but the rest of it is surprisingly functional.  Unfortunately it's not useful for very much at the moment.

This microscope has less magnification than a standard one.  It's also stereoscopic and produces a neat 3-D image of the surface.  It was typically used for performing dissections and other fine-detail work on small creatures.  It still works pretty well with an added light source, but what would you do with it?
